content.text: I envision a baler with a header that attaches to the arms of the Lifetrac, thus enabling the elevation of the pick-up header to be adjusted per field terrain as necessary. The baler plunger and bale tying apparatus will bolt or pin to the right side of the Lifetrac with the bales ejecting to the rear of the machine.
